metadata.coverage: National Wildlife Areas and Migratory Bird Sanctuaries in Ontario. Closed to hunting except waterfowl in designated areas of Big Creek and Long Point.
metadata.tenure: Federal protected area — closed to hunting

basis_notes.nwa_closed: National Wildlife Area. Hunting is prohibited, and so is possessing equipment that could be used for hunting, unless the regulation's own schedule authorises it for this area. It does not.
basis_notes.nwa_waterfowl: National Wildlife Area where the regulation authorises sport hunting of waterfowl only, in areas the Minister designates. Those designated areas are not published as a boundary, so this outline cannot tell you whether your spot is one of them. Nothing else may be hunted, and no toxic shot may be used.
basis_notes.nwa_no_entry: National Wildlife Area you may not even enter without a federal permit, let alone hunt.
basis_notes.nwa_unverified: Mapped by ECCC as a National Wildlife Area, but its name is not in the current regulation schedule, so we could not confirm which rules apply. Treat it as closed until Environment and Climate Change Canada says otherwise.
basis_notes.mbs_closed: Migratory Bird Sanctuary. Hunting migratory birds is prohibited, and separately you may not have any firearm or hunting appliance in your possession here at all. Together that closes it to hunting anything by any means, including walking through with a slung rifle after deer.
basis_notes.mbs_unverified: Mapped by ECCC as a Migratory Bird Sanctuary, but its name is not in the current regulation schedule, so we could not confirm which rules apply. Treat it as closed until Environment and Climate Change Canada says otherwise.

metadata.source: Canadian Protected and Conserved Areas Database (CPCAD), ECCC
metadata.hunting_source: Wildlife Area Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1609, under the Canada Wildlife Act; Migratory Bird Sanctuary Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1036, under the Migratory Birds Convention Act, 1994
metadata.extent_note: Hunting is authorised only in areas the Minister designates inside this boundary. Those designations are not published as geometry, so this outline cannot tell you whether your spot is one of them.
metadata.note: The boundaries are ECCC's; the prohibitions are the regulations'. In a sanctuary the possession of any firearm or hunting appliance is an offence in its own right, so it is closed to hunting anything by any means, not only to waterfowling.
